entities.summary: Elene Gok'ieli was a Soviet Georgian hurdler. She competed in the women's 80 metres hurdles at the 1952 Summer Olympics, setting a national record in the event. Gok'ieli was affiliated with Dynamo Tbilisi. In 1946, she was the national long jump champion, and was recognized as an Honoured Master of Sport of the USSR.
